title: Persistent Account Alignment & True Bottom Scroll Pinning
items: Fixed message bubble alignment swapping to the wrong side on page reload by binding 'Me' identification to persistent account UID and IP instead of ephemeral socket IDs
Added ResizeObserver to chat messages to keep scrolling pinned to the true bottom as images and media expand
Eliminated all remaining UI flicker and visual jumps across topic navigation and Explore feed
Persisted full account identity in local cache for instant 0ms hydration

title: Layout Stability & Zero-Latency Navigation Fix
items: Fixed topic entering visual bounce and flickering by eliminating layout-shifting translateY transitions across view containers
Persisted topic message history in localStorage for instant 0ms rendering across all visits
Fixed empty ghost message bubbles with orphan avatars
Optimized all view switching pipelines to be 100% instant and jitter-free

title: Comprehensive Code Cleanup & Performance Optimization
items: Optimized comment tree rendering with DocumentFragment and replaceChildren for instant comment expansion
Optimized topic lists rendering with atomic replaceChildren DOM updates
Cleaned admin CLI commands and multi-MAC authorization display
Audited all backend and frontend event pipelines for latency bottlenecks, memory leaks, and edge-case exceptions

title: Zero-Flicker Chat History & Instant Explore Navigation
items: Eliminated initial topic chat flicker and scroll jumping by replacing iterative message appending with atomic DocumentFragment batch rendering
Guarded image load auto-scrolling during history loading to prevent scroll bounces on high ping
Accelerated Explore feed with direct indexed SQLite sorting instead of full in-memory table scans
Instant 0ms Explore feed & post detail opening from client cache with seamless background reconciliation

title: Emergency Topic Navigation Fix
items: CRITICAL: Fixed undefined client-side sanitizeTopic call in goTopic that caused topic clicks to throw ReferenceError and freeze
Streamlined showChat and showLobby view transitions to guarantee clean state switches

title: Zero-Latency Optimistic Navigation & UI Fixes
items: Fixed slow navigation on high-ping servers: topic switching now renders immediately with 0ms optimistic transition and cached history
Restored header button text to 'Profile' permanently
Removed loading dimming state from topics list to prevent unresponsive click delay
Seamless background synchronization for chat messages and topic state

title: Client UI Persistence, Multi-Device MAC & Media Playback Optimization
items: Added multi-device MAC authorization: 1 account can stay logged in across unlimited devices simultaneously without kicking other sessions
Instant client UI hydration: topics, explore feed, profile, and view modes render immediately on page load from local cache with zero flicker
Dynamic client-side cache updates whenever topics, feed, or profile change on server
Added universal media playback coordinator: auto-pauses previous audio/video when a new track plays
Added IntersectionObserver auto-pause for off-screen media in Explore feeds and chat to save battery and network bandwidth
Optimized media delivery with async image decoding, lazy loading, metadata preloading, and Escape key lightbox exit

title: Strict MAC-Only Account Identification & Rate Limiting
items: Switched entire account identity and auto-login system to 100% device MAC address binding
Removed shared-IP auto-login and IP binding to eliminate account overlapping on shared WiFi/cellular networks
Isolated rate limiting (ACTION_LIMIT) per machine MAC address instead of global shared IP
Optimized and cleaned authentication handshake and key storage

title: Notification Fallbacks, Smooth Animations & Network Stability
items: Added notification permission status & one-click Enable/Unblock guidance in Profile menu
Added flashing tab title alert when new messages arrive while tab is inactive/minimized
Added multi-layer fallback for notifications (OS push -> audio chime -> tab title flash)
Fixed slow network UI stuttering: eliminated DOM blanking on explore feed and topic reloads via atomic replaceChildren
Added sleek top connection status banner instead of repeated intrusive error toasts during reconnects
Smooth hardware-accelerated micro-animations (viewFadeIn, popup scale, button active states) across all views

title: Instant voting & Zero-flicker UI
items: Fixed General chat notifications not triggering when sender and recipient both had default 'Anon' name
Enhanced browser notification reliability with live permission check, unfocused window support and click-to-open General topic
Optimistic instant feedback on Explore post Upvote/Downvote (0ms UI latency)
Added 200ms debounce protection on voting buttons to prevent rapid click cancellations
Fixed server vote recount response to accurately sync score and active user vote
Removed artificial fake loader overlay that caused dark screen flashing during navigation
Removed redundant 4s server topics broadcast and added client DOM diffing to eliminate Lobby flickering
Cached avatar group signature in topic header to prevent avatar redraw flashes
Cleaned visualViewport resize listener to prevent layout reflow flashing

title: Security hardening & bug fix audit
items: SECURITY: Blocked HTTP access to sensitive files (server.js, key.json, chat.db, hash.db)
Fixed Explore tags input missing from post composer (tags were always empty)
Fixed image/video/audio hash desync when removing files from Explore post preview
Fixed comment timestamps showing raw dates instead of relative time (just now, 5m ago)
Fixed pagination count off-by-one for post creator after publishing
Fixed sort/search filter being ignored when Explore feed was still loading
Fixed corrupted single-color gradient entries causing avatar rendering issues
Removed dead legacy explore-like handler and post_likes references
Removed duplicate CSS rules (.header-right z-index conflict, .bubble redundancy)
Raised Explore feed query limit from 500 to 10000 posts

title: Media streaming, Zoom & High-speed uploads
items: Smooth 60/120fps scrolling optimization (eliminated stutter/jank via passive rAF & CSS layout containment)
Numbered pagination bar for Explore posts (10 posts per page) with smart ellipsis
Dynamic Prev (hidden on page 1) and Next (hidden on last page) navigation controls
Fixed simultaneous description and media file support in Explore posts and cards
HTTP Range 206 partial content streaming for video/audio seeking and uninterrupted playback
Pinch-to-zoom and browser zoom layout fix (no elements cut off or covered)
High-speed direct binary stream upload pipeline for chat messages, explore posts and comments
50MB upload limits for both video and audio (MP3/OGG/WAV) in Explore mode
Removed background media destruction on tab switch to keep playback seamless

title: Explore, presence & moderation
items: Explore mode: posts with title, description, tags, images, likes, comments, share
Online presence: avatar group + client count in topic header
Click presence to see who's online; open user profiles from avatars/names
User profile stats: messages sent, media count, upload disk usage
Message seen counters (eye icon next to timestamp)
Unread topic badges on lobby (1 new / N new)
Moderator topic recommend (!recommendatopic) with blue badge
Moderator lock can apply to system topics; lock source shown (moderator vs author)
Lobby Topics / Explore segmented control; collapsible search & create
Topic list pagination via /p/N with scroll memory
Auto-load older messages when scrolling up

title: Topics, media & polish
items: System topics: General, Archive, Patch notes
Up to 5 image attachments per message (GIF supported, including paste)
Timezone: UTC or Vietnam (GMT+7) segmented control
Notification sounds (pop.wav / click.wav) with mute toggle
Topic lock / delete for authors
Topic list pagination
Link detection in messages (open in new tab)
Custom confirm dialogs and toast notifications

title: Profiles & safety
items: Avatar upload (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP)
Name change cooldown (7 days)
Empty / zalgo / invisible-character names auto-fixed
Anti-spam rate limits for messages, topics, posts, comments

title: Launch
items: Anonymous realtime chat
Topics with live online count
Reply to messages
